settings.heading: Benefits of Plant-Based Pea Protein & Organic Brown Rice Protein
settings.row_content: Say hello to the power-packed protein blend at the heart of our Orenda Shape®: Pea Protein and Organic Brown Rice Protein (15g). This isn't just any ordinary protein duo; it's a vibrant synergy that offers a full array of amino acids, inclusive of BCAAs and all the nine essentials your body craves but can't whip up independently. Our stellar team of proteins not only enhances your general well-being, but also champions your fitness aspirations and nutritional necessities, and kindles your metabolism like a well-tended fire.*

settings.heading: Learn more about Shape's Amino Acid profile
settings.row_content:
Our Orenda Shape® formulation boasts a carefully crafted blend of Pea and Organic Brown Rice proteins, providing a holistic approach to your protein intake. The magic lies in the harmony of these proteins, Pea and Organic Brown Rice proteins, each a complete source of all 9 essential amino acids, yet they shine in different areas. For instance, Pea protein? It's rich in lysine, an essential amino acid vital for protein synthesis and muscle recovery. But it's a tad low in cysteine and methionine.

And that's where Organic Brown Rice protein steps in! It's packed with cysteine and methionine, which support healthy skin, hair, nails, and metabolic processes.* However, it's a bit light on lysine. The solution? Combine them! Together, they create a superior amino acid profile that outclasses any single plant protein source, offering you all essential amino acids, including those all-important BCAAs (Branched Chain Amino Acids), for supporting muscle development and recovery.*

Orenda Shape® was designed to support your body in maintaining an active, balanced lifestyle. So whether you're vegan, vegetarian, or simply looking for a healthier protein alternative, Orenda Shape is here to support you in maintaining a balanced, nutritious lifestyle.

The nine essential amino acids are:

  • Histidine,
  • Isoleucine
  • Leucine
  • Lysine
  • Methionine
  • Phenylalanine
  • Threonine
  • Tryptophan
  • Valine

Of these three are BCAAs (Branched Chain Amino Acids):

  • Leucine
  • Isoleucine
  • Valine

The other amino acids in our protein blend are:

  • Alanine
  • Arginine
  • Aspartic
  • Cystine
  • Glutamic Acid
  • Glycine
  • Proline
  • Serine
  • Tyrosine

settings.heading: Benefits of Including 12 Types of Greens
settings.row_content:
Introducing the green powerhouses of our Orenda Shape formula - Spirulina, Organic Kamut Grass, Barley Grass, Wheat Grass, and
Spinach. These nutritional heroes aren't just for digestion; they're committed to supporting your overall well-being.*

Spirulina, a blue-green algae, is a complete protein, offering all essential amino acids, and is packed with antioxidants, aiding in cellular health and vitality. Organic Kamut Grass is a nutrient-dense grain that supports heart health and aids in supporting blood sugar levels.* Barley Grass, high in fiber and packed with vitamins, is your body's partner in detoxification, while Wheat Grass, rich in chlorophyll and various minerals, contributes to supporting energy levels and your immune system.*

Completing this remarkable lineup are Organic Oat Grass, Organic Flax, Chia Seed, Apple Fiber, Chlorella Powder, Pea Fiber, and Quinoa Sprout Powder. Each brings unique nutritional benefits, creating a blend that's as health-supporting as it is harmonious.

Organic Oat Grass offers a good dose of vitamins and minerals and supports a healthy inflammatory response, while Organic Flax and Chia Seed are both rich in omega-3 fatty acids, and offer digestive support. Apple Fiber aids in maintaining a healthy gut environment, while Chlorella Powder supports detoxification. Pea Fiber provides a feeling of fullness, aiding in support of weight management, and Quinoa Sprout Powder is a plant-based protein powerhouse.

Together, they form a nutritional ensemble, working in concert to enhance your health and vitality. With this blend of ingredients, you're not just fueling your body - you're investing in your wellness journey.

settings.heading: Can I take Orenda Shape® with other Orenda supplements?
settings.row_content:
Yes, Orenda Shape® can be taken with any Orenda supplements as part of your daily routine.

One of our favorite pairings is Orenda Shape® + Orenda CreatinePLUS. Shape is a plant-based protein powder with a full array of amino acids plus supportive greens like spirulina, organic flax, chia, and pea fiber. When you combine it with Orenda CreatinePLUS, it's a smart combo if you're looking to:

  • Support lean muscle
  • Boost your daily protein intake.
  • Feel ready for your workouts and active days*

As always, if you are pregnant or nursing, have a medical condition, consult with your healthcare professional before using this or any other dietary supplement.

settings.heading: What if I don't like the flavor or texture?
settings.row_content: If you don't love the flavor or texture, we got you. Try each flavor, finish the container, because you have our 30-day satisfaction guarantee. If you're unhappy for any reason, simply reach out to our friendly Customer Service team within 30 days of purchase for a full refund of your purchase price... no hard feelings! We'll even provide a return label for your convenience.

settings.heading: Should I take Orenda Shape® if I am on medication?
settings.row_content: Orenda Shape® was formulated with careful attention to safety. That said, if you are currently under medical care or taking any medications, we recommend consulting with your healthcare provider before adding any new supplement to your routine. Your healthcare provider understands your full health picture and is the right person to make that call with you.
